synopsis: The booklet identifies NI VeriStand with PXI and CompactRIO as commercial data-replay and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) tools [f8363, f9224]. Its listed capabilities include real-time testing, plant models, logging and HIL I/O, with plant models and I/O explicitly named as interfaces [f8643, f9226]. The evidence listed is general HIL evidence, rather than a more specific validation claim [f9225]. A PXIe-8842 controller costs about USD 5,200, but this covers only the controller—not a HIL bench—and a complete NI VeriStand/PXI/CompactRIO system requires a quote [f9227, f16035]. No latest release was found, leaving release currency unresolved in the booklet [f9228].

relations.note: Glossary repeats controller price and clarifies that it does not cover a HIL bench.
Adds specific real-time testing, modeling, logging and I/O capabilities to the tool listing.
Listed plant-model and I/O interfaces support the stated HIL capabilities.
Qualifies the evidence behind the capabilities as general HIL evidence.
